quadrant.title: Views × Intent quadrant
quadrant.subtitle: Every published post on two independent axes: how far it travelled compared with its account's median (×{multiplier} to count as high) and how much of its audience saved it ({saveRate} to count as high). Under {minViews} views the save rate is not readable — the post does not move up. Scores recomputed by the nightly sync.
quadrant.empty: No post can be plotted for this period.

tooltip.pending: Pending — under {hours} h, too early to judge.
tooltip.breakout: Published inside the window of a big post from the same account: distribution may be borrowed.

info.title: This chart answers one question: for each post, where is the problem? A post can fail in two different ways: TikTok did not distribute it (a hook problem), or it was seen but nobody showed any interest in the product (a product-intro problem). These two failures are fixed in opposite ways — this chart separates them so you don't fix the wrong thing.
info.axisX: Did TikTok push this post? Measured against the account's median over {windowDays} days: a post is 'high' if it did at least ×{multiplier} the median of ITS OWN account. It is relative: 10,000 views is a burst on a small account and an ordinary day on a big one.
info.axisY: Did viewers show product interest? Measured by the save rate (saves ÷ views), threshold at {saveRate}. A save = 'I'm keeping this for later' — it is the signal most correlated with sales in our history. Likes measure emotion, saves measure intent.
info.scale: Distributed AND saved: the hook lands and the product appeals. Action: run this format/hook again, it is a proven winner.
info.intent_faible: TikTok distributed it but nobody saves: people watch without taking an interest in the product. The hook is good — leave it alone. The problem is the bridge to the product: mentioned too late, unclear, or missing. Action: tighten the product intro.
info.distribution_faible: Few views but a high save rate: the small audience reached is strongly interested in the product. The angle is good — keep it. It is the hook that did not land hard enough for TikTok to push. Action: change the hook, keep the angle.
info.archiver: Neither distribution nor interest. One failed run can be bad luck (TikTok distribution is a lottery): archive after 2 failed runs, not 1.
info.pending: A post under {hours}h old is not classified: its views are still climbing, and classifying it now would give a false verdict. Classification settles at {hours}h.
info.breakout: This post was published within {windowHours}h of a breakout (≥{minViews}) from the same account. Its numbers are probably inflated by the breakout's redistribution — read its classification with caution, it is not necessarily its own performance.
info.autre: Post never marked warmup or promo in Jarvia. Qualify it so that filters and readings are accurate.

coverage.allClassified: {published} posts published in the period, all classified.
coverage.summary: {classified} posts classified out of {published} published in the period — {unclassified} unclassified:

cause.warmup: {count, plural, one {# post excluded} other {# posts excluded}} by the page's “Excluding warmup” filter: warm-up content, outside this reading. Switch the Warmup filter to “All” to see them.
cause.pending: {count, plural, one {# post under {hours}h old} other {# posts under {hours}h old}}: too early to judge.
cause.not_measured: {count, plural, one {# post never measured} other {# posts never measured}}: no view reading at all, which is not a zero.
cause.no_baseline: {count, plural, one {# post on an account with no reference median} other {# posts on accounts with no reference median}}: fewer than {minPosts} measured posts over {windowDays} days.
cause.no_views: {count, plural, one {# post with 0 measured views} other {# posts with 0 measured views}}: no denominator for a save rate.
cause.saves_unavailable: {count, plural, one {# post with UNMEASURABLE intent} other {# posts with UNMEASURABLE intent}}: Instagram and YouTube do not expose saves. No threshold setting will change that.
cause.saves_collecting: {count, plural, one {# post predating saves collection} other {# posts predating saves collection}}: the measure will land for the next ones.
cause.not_computed: {count, plural, one {# post not classified yet} other {# posts not classified yet}}: waiting for the next nightly sync.
cause.qualification: {count, plural, one {# post hidden} other {# posts hidden}} by the card's Qualification filter.

actionSub.scale: Distributed and saved. Winning format, replay it as is.
actionSub.distribution_faible: The angle appeals, the opening does not land. Keep the angle, rewrite the hook.
actionSub.intent_faible: Seen but not saved. The hook works, the bridge to the product breaks.
actionSub.archiver: Neither distribution nor interest. One failed run can be bad luck.
